steps.en: Install the fetchers extra, then download the browsers
steps.zh: 装 fetchers 扩展，再下载浏览器

steps.en: Turn on adaptive mode and fetch the page with the stealth fetcher
steps.zh: 打开自适应开关，用隐身抓取器取页面

steps.en: Launches a patched Chromium, hides automation traces, returns a parsed page
steps.zh: 启动打过补丁的 Chromium，抹掉自动化痕迹，返回已解析的页面

steps.en: Select what you want and ask it to remember the element
steps.zh: 选出要的元素，并让它记住

steps.en: Saves the element's tag, text, attributes, path and parent to SQLite
steps.zh: 把元素的标签、文字、属性、路径和父节点存进 SQLite

steps.en: Run the same selector again, now with adaptive on
steps.zh: 同一个选择器再跑一次，带上 adaptive

steps.en: Scores every element against the saved one and returns the closest match
steps.zh: 拿页面上每个元素和存档比相似度，返回最像的

value.en: A redesign no longer means rewriting selectors by hand, and the fetch, stealth browser and parser come from one package
value.zh: 网站改版后不用手改选择器；取页面、隐身浏览器和解析出自同一个包

sources: https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling README.md — Installation > Optional Dependencies (pip install "scrapling[fetchers]", scrapling install); opening example (StealthyFetcher.adaptive = True, p.css('.product', auto_save=True), p.css('.product', adaptive=True))
https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling docs/fetching/choosing.md — page = StealthyFetcher.fetch('https://example.com'); fetcher comparison table (Chromium and Google Chrome, Playwright API)
